'''2001 Normal DPC Geoff Snider geoff's Hidden PHIL''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Geoff Snider]] posted on DeckTech after playing it at [[2001 Normal DPC]]. The description says: 'hidden base retrieval that i played at DPC normal.' No result is given.<ref name="dt-14045">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14045 geoff's Hidden PHIL], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 26 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14045/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14045/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018043123/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14045/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''geoff's Hidden PHIL'''
* '''Author:''' Geoff "gsiva" Snider
* '''Published:''' February 26, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' hidden base retrieval that i played at DPC normal.  nothing really special, but fun to play, and it's really helped me with my tracking.

=== Strategy ===

retrieval is fun, and if you can't see how this deck works, then you're not good enough to play it.  it WILL LOSE to some decks...HANDS DOWN.  it's not the deck, but the playa'     Nuff Said.
